name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
provider: Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education
summary: A central scholarship for meritorious students from economically weaker families, intended to help students continue from secondary through higher secondary school. Fresh awards are for eligible Class 9 students; renewals may continue through Classes 10–12.
benefits: ₹12,000 per year, subject to selection and renewal conditions.

eligibility.previousClass: At least 55% in Class 7 for the selection test; 5 percentage-point relaxation for SC/ST students
eligibility.selection: State/UT selection examination and merit list

requiredDocuments: Bank account details and other items requested by NSP
applicationProcess: For the 2026–27 cycle, selected students apply through the National Scholarship Portal after One-Time Registration. Check the portal for the next cycle and renewal instructions.
statusNote: The 2026–27 student application deadline was extended to 15 November 2026. Institute and district verification deadlines continue after that date.

name: PM YASASVI – Top Class Education in Schools
provider: Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
summary: Financial support for eligible OBC, EBC and DNT students studying in schools identified under the Top Class Schools scheme. Selection is merit-based and depends on the notified school list and available state/class slots.
benefits: Benefit amount and eligible components should be confirmed in the current scheme guidelines and NSP listing before publication to students.

eligibility.schoolRequirement: Must be studying in a school identified as a Top Class School under the scheme
eligibility.selection: State-wise merit based on marks in the previous class; limited slots apply

requiredDocuments: School and identity details requested by NSP
applicationProcess: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal when the scheme is open. Confirm that the school and state are eligible in the current NSP notice.
statusNote: NSP announced fresh applications from 22 October 2026, with a 30 November deadline. The NSP notice says applicants from Rajasthan, Keralam and Karnataka must wait for a further update; check the portal before acting.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students
provider: Department of Social Justice & Empowerment / State and UT Governments
summary: A centrally sponsored scheme supporting full-time Class 9 and 10 students belonging to Scheduled Caste communities. Applications and implementation are handled through the student's domicile State or UT.
benefits: Consolidated academic allowance: ₹3,500 per year for day scholars and ₹7,000 per year for hostellers, subject to current state implementation rules.

eligibility.domicile: Apply through the State/UT of domicile

requiredDocuments: Bank details and documents required by the State/UT portal
applicationProcess: Check the current notification from your domicile State/UT and the National Scholarship Portal. State/UT authorities invite and process applications.
statusNote: A current 2026–27 application window was not confirmed in the official scheme page checked on 22 November 2026. Verify the relevant State/UT notification.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for ST Students
provider: Ministry of Tribal Affairs / State and UT Governments
summary: A centrally sponsored scholarship for eligible Scheduled Tribe students studying in Classes 9 and 10. The domicile State/UT invites applications and manages verification and disbursement.
benefits: The Ministry's scheme page lists ₹225 per month for day scholars and ₹525 per month for hostellers for 10 months; confirm the current State/UT implementation notice.
requiredDocuments: Bank account details and documents requested by the State/UT
applicationProcess: Check the Ministry of Tribal Affairs scheme page and your domicile State/UT scholarship portal for the current application window.
statusNote: Application dates are state-managed; a nationwide open deadline was not confirmed in the official source checked on 22 November 2026.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
summary: A central scholarship for eligible students with benchmark disabilities studying in Classes 9 and 10. Applications are submitted through the National Scholarship Portal.
benefits: The department's scheme page lists monthly support and annual book/disability allowances; check the latest guidelines for the applicable rate and fee coverage.

eligibility.identity: UDID requirements apply; check the current NSP instructions
eligibility.otherScholarship: Restrictions may apply if receiving another scholarship or stipend

requiredDocuments: Identity and bank details requested by NSP
applicationProcess: Follow the current Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities and NSP instructions. The department notes that UDID data consent is required before applying.
statusNote: NSP listed the 2026–27 application window as closed on 31 October 2026. Check for any official extension or the next cycle.
